_aciklama: Bölüm tanımları. building: turkish (eski Türk apartmanı, HİCRET APARTMANI) | modern (renkli tuğla apartman) | factory (16–20: dev eşyalar fabrikası; factory = {length, width, height, gate: [genişlik, yükseklik], decor: tub|pedestal|gift|desk|kitchen, maze: fabrika malzemelerinden labirent sırası sayısı 0–6; salon boyu eşyaya göre otomatik uzar}). goal: door (daire kapısına teslim), room (odaya taşı), spot (tam yerine, ön yüz odaya bakacak şekilde yerleştir; 6. bölümden itibaren tüm bölümler spot: eve girip eşyayı yerine koymak gerekir). theme: 0-5 renk teması. Ölçüler metre. corridor.turn: none | left | right. Engeller: cat, lamp, shoe_rack, plant, door, boxes. at: hall, flightA, flightB, mid, landing (floor ile), corridor, corridor2, room.

levels.name: First Day
levels.subtitle: Bring the box up to the 1st floor door.

levels.name: Kitchen Box
levels.subtitle: Plates inside. No hard knocks!
tips: When the box gets close to a wall, that edge glows yellow.
Push the joystick gently to walk or turn slowly.

levels.name: Handle With Care
levels.subtitle: Carry the TV into the living room.
tips: The screen (front) takes double damage.
Swipe on the right side to rotate the TV.
Keep the screen away from the walls in the corridor.

levels.name: Second Floor
levels.subtitle: Big screen, narrow stairs with railings.
tips: A cat wanders on the stairs. Don't hit it!
Tilt the wide screen to fit narrow stairs.
Use the TOP camera to see tight spots.

levels.name: Glass Table
levels.subtitle: Glass top. Mind the hanging lamps.
tips: The glass top takes double damage.
Use LIFT / LOWER to pass under low lamps.

levels.name: Giant Screen
levels.subtitle: Very narrow stairs. Set the TV up in its corner of the living room.
tips: The screen must face the room.
Hold FINE to rotate slowly.
Put the TV down to close the open door.

levels.name: Sofa Time
levels.subtitle: Bring the sofa inside and set it against the living room wall.
tips: The ghost outline shows the exact spot. The seat faces the room.
Turning on the landing needs space: lift the sofa or stand it up.
ROLL mode tilts it on its side.

levels.name: Tight Door
levels.subtitle: Narrow door, turning corridor. Put the sofa in its place.
tips: The ghost outline shows the exact spot.
The sofa won't go through sideways: point the long side at the door.
Stand the sofa upright to get around the corner.

levels.name: Corner Trouble
levels.subtitle: Two floors, a tight corridor and a cat. The sofa goes by the wall.
tips: Push the sofa's back against the wall.
The sofa is heavy: take a REST when your stamina is low.

levels.name: Wardrobe
levels.subtitle: Tall wardrobe, low ceiling. Set it up in the bedroom.
tips: Mirrors must face the room.
Tilt the wardrobe to match the slope of the stairs.
The mirror doors (front) are fragile.

levels.name: Low Ceiling
levels.subtitle: Put the wardrobe in its spot in the bedroom.
tips: The ghost outline shows the exact spot.
Mirrors must face the room.

levels.name: Spiral Up
levels.subtitle: Three floors of low, winding stairs.
tips: Keep the wardrobe upright when turning on landings.

levels.name: Laundry Day
levels.subtitle: Install the washing machine in the laundry room.
tips: It's heavy: you'll get tired fast.
Pick it up from the front so the door faces you, then back it into the slot.
The glass door (front) is fragile.

levels.name: Spin Cycle
levels.subtitle: Narrow stairs, two floors, one heavy washer.
tips: Rest on the landings before you run out of stamina.

levels.name: Cold Cargo
levels.subtitle: Fridge on your back, steep stairs. Install it in the kitchen.
tips: If your stamina runs out, the fridge falls on you!
REST puts it down so you can catch your breath.
Back the fridge into its slot so the door faces the room.

levels.name: Rubber Ducky
levels.subtitle: Welcome to the Giant Goods Factory. This duck is five times your height!
tips: You are tiny. The duck is not.
Use TOP or 1P to see around giant objects.
Drop it in the giant bathtub, beak facing forward.

levels.name: Bolt From the Blue
levels.subtitle: Seven times your height. Lay it down to fit through the gate.
tips: The gate is lower than the bolt: swipe up/down to tip it over.
Stand it back up on the display stand.

levels.name: Teddy XXL
levels.subtitle: A huggable giant. Turn it sideways to squeeze through the gate.
tips: The bear is wider than the gate: rotate it a quarter turn.
Teddy goes into the giant gift box, face first.

levels.name: Mega Pencil
levels.subtitle: Ten times your height. Mind the ceiling!
tips: Lay the pencil down to pass the gate, then stand it up again.
The sharp tip (top) is fragile.

levels.name: Fridge of Doom
levels.subtitle: The final boss: a fridge ten times your height.
tips: It's heavy: if your stamina runs out, it falls on you!
Tip it over to pass the gate, rest, then stand it up in the giant kitchen.
